en: Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a church at the end of a snow-covered path lined with leafless birch trees and wooden fences. A domed tower rises above the main entrance. In the foreground, two children sit on a sled on the snowy path, with another person walking toward the church door in the distance. Printed captions at the top read "Kyrkan." on the left and "Piteå." on the right.
